name: The Colorado Rockies
seasonNote: Come down from Wyoming in late summer or fall: Trail Ridge Road and the high passes are open, and by late September the aspens turn the mountains gold around Telluride, Aspen, and Vail. The Great Sand Dunes' Medano Creek is a late-spring feature, so it may be dry by fall.
summary: The Front Range and the high country: Fort Collins, Rocky Mountain National Park, Boulder, mile-high Denver, and Colorado Springs' Garden of the Gods and Pikes Peak; then a loop through the tallest dunes in America, the cliff dwellings of Mesa Verde and the Durango steam train, Telluride's box canyon, the Black Canyon of the Gunnison, the hot springs of Glenwood, and the legendary ski towns of Aspen, Vail, and Breckenridge.
